data.heading: Week 1 (06 March - 12 March 2026):
data.text: -  Over the plains of Northwest India & adjoining Central India, maximum temperatures are likely to rise by 2-3° C during next 4 days and no significant change during subsequent 3 days. Hence, Maximum temperatures are likely to continue to be above normal by 4-6°C

data.heading: Details of each Segment
data.text:
- over many parts of Northwest & 3-5°C over adjoining Central India during most days of the week.
-  No significant change in maximum temperatures likely over rest parts of the country.
-  Minimum  temperatures  are  likely  to  be  above  normal  (by  1-3°C)  over  most  parts  of northwest  and  adjoining  central  India,  and  northeast  &  adjoining  east  India,  and  below normal (by 1-3°C) or near normal over the rest of the country

data.heading: Week 2 (13 March - 19 March 2026):
data.text:
-  Maximum temperatures  are  likely  to  be  above  normal  (by  3-5°C)  over  most  parts  of  the country except interior peninsular India & adjoining central India, where they are likely to be near normal or slightly above normal by 1-2°C.
-  Minimum  temperatures  are  likely  to  be  above  normal  (by  1-3°C)  over  most  parts  of northwest  and  adjoining  central  India,  and  northeast  &  adjoining  east  India,  and  below normal (by 1-3°C) or near normal over the rest of the country.

data.heading: Rabi Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Rice: About 21.80 lakh ha area coverage under Summer Rice has been reported as compared to 23.45 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Pulses: About 1.15 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 1.03 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Oilseeds: About  1.69  lakh  ha  area  coverage  has  been  reported  compared  to  1.26  lakh  ha during the corresponding period of last year.
